title: AI Inbox is one list with chips; Servex needs a restart

owner_note.text: The Inbox at /framework/ai/ now reads state.json with chips Live, New, Recent, Older, Needs you and a Kind row (landed 8f06e9daa). Decisions: the old prompt, say, group and changed-page rows are gone from the list (one row type); New includes every queued ask and every idle task from the last 7 days (313 now); a chip on hides the pinned blocks; a parked ask no longer counts as waiting. merge.mjs got a --review-dir flag because the review gate only scans the last 4 days of session dirs. Risk: State.mjs changed, so the mastermind restarts Servex. /framework/ai/tasks/ empty share is over 0.6 at 1920/3440, as it was before this task.
